options.title: Human
options.description: The most common race in the world. Humans vary widely in size, strength, intelligence, and moral alignment.

options.title: Fish-Men
options.description: Humanoid beings with traits from various aquatic animals. Possess immense strength and breathe underwater. Masters of Fish-Man Karate.

options.title: Merfolk
options.description: Half-human, half-fish beings. Graceful swimmers; tails split into legs at age 30.

options.title: Sky Islanders
options.description: Winged humans from islands above the clouds. Use Dial technology.

options.title: Minks
options.description: Furry humanoid animals with mammal traits. Use Electro and gain Sulong form under full moon.

options.title: Giants
options.description: Enormous humanoids from Elbaf, the warrior island.

options.title: Lunarians
options.description: Ancient race with dark skin, white hair, flaming wings; manipulate flames; nearly extinct.

options.title: Cyborgs
options.description: Humans modified with mechanical enhancements.

options.title: Zombies
options.description: Reanimated corpses created through Moria's shadow powers.

options.title: Skeleton
options.description: A human soul revived inside a reanimated skeleton body.

options.title: Artificial Humans
options.description: Created by Vegapunk and other scientists; Seraphim and Vinsmoke siblings.

options.title: Wotans
options.description: Rare hybrids between Fish-Men and Giants.

options.title: Longarm Tribe
options.description: Humanoids with two elbows per arm. From Kenzan island.

options.title: Longleg Tribe
options.description: Humanoids with extremely long legs; rivals of Longarm Tribe.

options.title: Snakeneck Tribe
options.description: Rare humanoids with long, snake-like necks.

options.title: Buccaneer Race
options.description: Mysterious race with giant-like strength; oppressed by World Government. Bartholomew Kuma's race.

options.title: Tontatta
options.description: Tiny people from Green Bit; incredible strength and speed; honest and loyal.

options.title: Fairies
options.description: Dressrosan name for invisible-thieving Tontatta. Not a separate race.

options.title: Automata
options.description: Sentient beings made from objects/animals with human souls embedded.

options.title: Pacifistas
options.description: Genetically modified clones with cyborg parts and Lunarian DNA. By Vegapunk.

options.title: Toy
options.description: Transformed into a wooden toy by the Hobby-Hobby Fruit; everyone forgot you exist.

options.title: Demons
options.description: Transformed into a demon by Imu; immortal, monstrous strength, but soul/free-will lost.

options.title: Three-Eye Tribe
options.description: Rare race with a third eye granting heightened perception.

options.title: Dosundada
options.description: Hybrid of humans and Tontatta dwarves.

options.title: Zushindodo
options.description: Extremely rare hybrid of giants and dwarves.
